evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: To bridge this gap, we introduce $\textbf{AgenticFinBench}$, a benchmark of 230 real-world financial tasks spanning 8 categories, 2 languages, and 4 complexity levels.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Financial tasks vary widely in type and difficulty, and many are open-ended with no ground-truth answers.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Experiments across 18 agent configurations reveal three key findings: (1) Ignoring hallucinations can overstate agent performance: hallucination auditing lowers the baseline leader's score by 7.58 points and moves it to fourth place. (2) Harness differences explain more variation in evidence grounding than model differences (28.6% vs 8.8%). (3) Quality scores fall from 89.44 on direct retrieval to 79.18 on the most complex tasks.
